description: This file defines the class WorkEffortServices, which provides various static service methods related to work efforts in the OFBiz framework. The methods include retrieval of work effort events, tasks, activities, summaries, and processing reminders. It interacts with entities like WorkEffort, WorkEffortAndPartyAssign, WorkEffortAndGoods, and others, and handles complex date-based logic, entity relations, and permissions.

classes.name: WorkEffortServices
classes.description: A service class providing static methods for managing work efforts and related activities in the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getWorkEffortAssignedEventsForRole
methods.description: Retrieves work effort events assigned to a specific role for a user, filtering by current status and role type.

methods.name: getWorkEffortAssignedEventsForRoleOfAllParties
methods.description: Retrieves all work effort events for a given role across all parties, filtering by current status.

methods.name: getWorkEffortAssignedTasks
methods.description: Fetches tasks assigned to the current user, including filtering by assignment status and type.

methods.name: getWorkEffortAssignedActivities
methods.description: Obtains activities assigned to the user, considering various status and role conditions.

methods.name: getWorkEffortAssignedActivitiesByRole
methods.description: Fetches activities assigned to the user based on their role, using specific entity relation.

methods.name: getWorkEffortAssignedActivitiesByGroup
methods.description: Retrieves activities assigned to the user's group, filtered by current status.

methods.name: getWorkEffort
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific work effort, including permission checks and related party assignments.

methods.name: groupCalendarEntriesByDateRange
methods.description: Groups calendar entries into date ranges based on intersections with input date range.

methods.name: getDefaultWorkEffortExprList
methods.description: Creates default entity condition list for querying work efforts based on calendar type and party IDs.

methods.name: getWorkEffortEventsByPeriod
methods.description: Retrieves work effort events over a specified period, considering start date, period type, and other filters, including recurring efforts.

methods.name: getProductManufacturingSummaryByFacility
methods.description: Provides a summary of manufacturing work efforts by facility for a given product, including incoming and outgoing quantities.

methods.name: processWorkEffortEventReminders
methods.description: Processes reminders for work effort events, sending notifications based on temporal expressions and scheduled times.

methods.name: processWorkEffortEventReminder
methods.description: Handles the logic for a specific work effort event reminder, including email notification and recurrence updates.

methods.name: removeDuplicateWorkEfforts
methods.description: Removes duplicate work effort entries from a list based on their identifiers.
